accounts.signin.awaiting_confirmation.note: Sign-in finished but registration waits for confirmation of the observed name.

accounts.enrollment.add.note: Starts another person's sign-in, or confirms an existing account first.

accounts.enrollment.begin.note: Opens sign-in to observe the Microsoft name before confirmation.

accounts.enrollment.observed_name.note: Confirmation title. name is the observed Microsoft display name, never a typed app label.

accounts.enrollment.confirm.note: Confirms the observed name with the current confirmation token.

accounts.enrollment.cancel.note: Discards pending confirmation without registering a new account.

accounts.enrollment.same_name_limit.text: Two people with the same Microsoft display name cannot be told apart. Confirm only if this is your account.
accounts.enrollment.same_name_limit.note: Required limitation beside the observed name. A display name is not a unique identity.

accounts.identity.confirmed.note: The person confirmed the Microsoft display name.

accounts.identity.unconfirmed.note: No confirmed Microsoft identity is stored for this account.

accounts.identity.unknown.note: Identity or last identity check is unavailable. Never treat it as a match.

accounts.identity.match.note: Last identity check matched the confirmed name.

accounts.identity.mismatch.note: Last identity check found a different Microsoft name.

accounts.identity.last_check.note: Account row identity check. result is the localized match, mismatch or unknown label.

accounts.identity.checked_at.note: Last identity check timestamp, formatted with the selected region.

accounts.title.note: Accounts page heading and document title.

accounts.balance.none.note: Account row balance when no points balance has been read. This is unknown, not zero, and is not a sign-in failure.

accounts.default_label.note: Fallback account label. number is its one-based position, not an identifier.

accounts.empty.title.note: Empty Accounts state, if displayed before the shell returns to setup.

accounts.empty.body.text: Sign in, then pick when the app checks for points

accounts.empty.action.note: Empty-state action navigates to setup, not an undocumented add-account API.

accounts.action.signin.note: Starts Microsoft sign-in for the account. Existing accounts use sign_in_again; adding another account first confirms any existing unconfirmed account.

accounts.action.signin_again.note: Calls sign_in_again for an existing account, also for updated Microsoft terms.

accounts.action.rename.note: Opens the inline account label editor.

accounts.action.more.note: Closed per-account disclosure replacing always-visible Rename, Pause or Resume, and Remove buttons. Sign in remains outside; no action or confirmation is removed.

accounts.action.pause.note: Excludes the selected account from scheduled runs, subject to last-active validation.

accounts.action.resume.note: Returns a paused account to active runs.

accounts.rename.label.note: Label of the shared textField in the inline rename editor, maximum forty characters.

accounts.rename.description.text: This changes the name in the app, not your Microsoft account
accounts.rename.description.note: Explains that renaming writes only the local label.

accounts.root_pause.text: This older account cannot be paused. Use a Manual schedule to stop scheduled runs.
accounts.root_pause.note: Visible reason for no Pause action on the root profile, per section 8.4.

accounts.remove.title.note: Destructive confirmation title. account is a user-supplied label, isolated by i18n.

accounts.remove.body.text: Remove it from the app. You can keep its browser data, or send it to the Recycle Bin. This does not delete your Microsoft account.
accounts.remove.body.note: Removal dialog for a named profile, explains both delete_data choices.

accounts.remove.root_body.text: This older account can only be removed with its browser data. The data goes to the Recycle Bin. This does not delete your Microsoft account.
accounts.remove.root_body.note: Root-profile confirmation, delete_data must be true. Use Windows' official localized Recycle Bin name.

accounts.remove.keep.note: Destructive action calls remove_account with delete_data false for a named profile.

accounts.remove.delete.text: Remove and move data to the Recycle Bin
accounts.remove.delete.note: Destructive action calls remove_account with delete_data true. Use the official localized Windows Recycle Bin name.

accounts.remove.success.note: Shown only after remove_account succeeds, never for root_recycle_failed.

accounts.signin.title.note: Heading above the active or terminal sign-in status.

accounts.signin.starting.note: SigninStatus starting, the app has requested a sign-in process.

accounts.signin.waiting.text: Finish signing in using the Edge window. If Windows is already signed in with a Microsoft account, the app may connect that account for you.
accounts.signin.waiting.note: SigninStatus waiting. The person signs in with their own Microsoft account in Edge. Enrollment then asks them to confirm the name Microsoft displays before registering the account.

accounts.signin.verifying.text: Checking that your sign-in was saved
accounts.signin.verifying.note: SigninStatus verifying after the visible window closes or the first balance check misses it.

accounts.signin.signed_in.note: SigninStatus signed_in; a terms_of_use warning can still follow.

accounts.signin.failed.text: Sign-in could not finish. Try again.
accounts.signin.failed.note: SigninStatus failed fallback when no specific error message_key was supplied.

accounts.signin.timed_out.text: Sign-in took too long. Try again when you are ready.
accounts.signin.timed_out.note: SigninStatus timed_out, fifteen-minute limit, do not claim the account was deleted.

accounts.signin.cancelled.note: SigninStatus cancelled, shown only after cancellation is confirmed by status.

accounts.signin.busy.text: A run is using Edge. Wait for it to finish, then try signing in again.
accounts.signin.busy.note: SigninStatus busy, distinct from a bridge response error.

accounts.signin.cancelling.note: After cancel_signin accepts the request, before the cancelled terminal push.

accounts.signin.terms.text: Accept Microsoft's terms in the sign-in window before continuing
accounts.signin.terms.note: Instruction when signed_in carries error_code terms_of_use.

accounts.signin.retry.note: Retry label for a terminal failed, timed_out, cancelled or busy state.

accounts.migration.title.note: Confirmation when adding another account requires moving the existing root profile. Continue retries add_account with confirm_migration true only after explicit confirmation.

accounts.migration.confirm.note: Retries add_account with confirm_migration true after explicit confirmation.

accounts.load.title.note: Bridge fetch failure heading, followed by the localized error and retry action.

accounts.invited.title.note: Heading within the same list as connected accounts. These are local notes, not app accounts.

accounts.invited.status.note: Chip on a local friend note. It does not claim that Microsoft confirmed a referral.

accounts.invited.empty.note: Empty local friend-note list, not Microsoft's observed friend list.

accounts.invited.add.note: Opens a local note editor. It does not send an invitation or start sign-in.

accounts.invited.edit.note: Edits only the local friend's name and entered email.

accounts.invited.name.note: Required local friend name, one to forty characters.

accounts.invited.email.note: Email entered by the user for a local note, not a verified Microsoft identity.

accounts.invited.save.note: Saves the local note without contacting the friend.

accounts.invited.remove.note: Opens or confirms removal of a local note only.

accounts.invited.remove_title.note: Confirmation title for deleting a local friend note. name is user supplied.

accounts.invited.remove_body.text: This only removes the note from this app. It does not change your Microsoft referrals.
accounts.invited.remove_body.note: Distinguishes local removal from a Microsoft account or referral action.

accounts.invited.auto_farm.note: Label of a disabled off switch for invited friends. No automation is available for these notes.

accounts.invited.auto_farm_disabled.text: Auto-farm is off for invited friends
accounts.invited.auto_farm_disabled.note: Accessible explanation for the disabled switch. Invited friends never have app account actions.

accounts.referrals.title.note: Referral information read from the user's connected Microsoft account, below the combined list.

accounts.referrals.link.note: Read-only verified referral link. Never use the local friend notes as its source.

accounts.referrals.copy.note: Copies in the user's click gesture or selects the field if clipboard access fails.

accounts.referrals.copied.note: Shown only after the clipboard write succeeds.

accounts.referrals.select.text: Link selected. Copy it with your keyboard.
accounts.referrals.select.note: Clipboard fallback feedback. Do not claim it was copied.

accounts.referrals.link_unknown.note: Shown instead of a link or copy button when no readable link was returned.

accounts.referrals.referrals.note: Microsoft's observed referral count. Null is unknown, never zero.

accounts.referrals.friends.note: Count of Microsoft's observed friends, not the local invited-friend notes. Null is unknown.

accounts.referrals.unknown.note: Unmeasured referral figure. Never replace a null value with zero.

accounts.referrals.read_at.note: Timestamp of the observed referral information, formatted with the selected region.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.not_read.text: Referral details have not been read yet.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.not_read.note: No stored referral observation is available.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.signed_out.text: Sign in again to read your referral details.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.signed_out.note: The connected account was signed out when the page was read.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.challenge.text: Microsoft needs you to complete a check before referral details can be read.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.challenge.note: A verification challenge prevented the referral reader from continuing.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.page_unkno.text: The referral page could not be recognized.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.page_unkno.note: The reader did not recognize a supported referral page.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_missi.text: No invitation link was found on the referral page.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_missi.note: The page was read but no qualifying link was present.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_ambig.text: More than one invitation link was found, so none is shown.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_ambig.note: The reader refuses to choose between different candidate links.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_inval.text: The invitation link could not be verified, so it is not shown.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.link_inval.note: A candidate link failed the backend's validation.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.read_faile.text: Referral details could not be read this time.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.read_faile.note: The reader reported a failure without a more specific state.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.storage_fa.text: Referral details were read but could not be saved.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.storage_fa.note: The observation could not be persisted. Do not offer an unverified link.

accounts.referrals.unreadable.storage_un.text: Saved referral details could not be read.
accounts.referrals.unreadable.storage_un.note: Stored referral information is corrupt, inconsistent or unavailable.
